serverUserAndClientForThisWorkspace: Server, user, and client for this workspace.
thatPathIsNotInThisWorkspace: That path is not in this workspace.

couldNotReadTheWorkspaceFolder: Could not read the workspace folder.
label: Label
replaceTheFileEvenWhenYouAlreadyHaveThat: Replace the file even when you already have that revision.
keepFilesChangedWithoutBeingCheckedOut: Keep files changed without being checked out.
getRevisionsOnlyForFilesListedInThisChan: Get revisions only for files listed in this changelist.
removeWorkspaceFilesThatAreAbsentFromThi: Remove workspace files that are absent from this label.
theServerWantsAPasswordBeforeThisWorkspa: The server wants a password before this workspace can be read.
multipleResolves: Showing the first of {{count}} pending resolves. The selected action applies to all of them.
autoMergeHint: Merge changes that do not conflict. Leave conflicts unresolved.
acceptTheirsHint: Replace the workspace version with the incoming revision.
selectAFileToSeeItsDiff: Select a file to see its diff
createsAnEmptyNumberedChangelistOnThisCl: Creates an empty numbered changelist on this client.
thisRemovesTheShelvedFilesForThisChangel: Remove this changelist's shelved content from the server. Opened files and private stream edits stay in the workspace.
thisDiscardsTheOpenedChangesAndRestoresT: This discards the opened changes and restores the have revision. A shelf on the server is left in place.
thisRemovesTheAddedFilesFromTheChangelis: This removes the added files from the changelist and deletes them from disk.
addedFilesAreDeletedFromDiskOtherOpenedF: Added files are deleted from disk. Other opened files go back to the revision you have.

yoursAndTheirsHaveTheSameText: Yours and theirs have the same text.

move.title: Rename or move file
move.description: Move a versioned file and preserve its history and changelist.
move.hint: The destination folder must exist. An unopened file is checked out first. Existing files are never overwritten.
move.failed: The move failed. Check the operation error and destination, then retry.

deleteChange.title: Delete changelist {{id}}?
deleteChange.description: This removes only your empty pending changelist. Changelists with opened or shelved files cannot be deleted.
deleteChange.failed: The changelist could not be deleted. Refresh to check whether files or a shelf were added.

ticketExpired: The ticket for {{target}} is missing or expired.

status.moreUsers_one: {{count}} more user has this file open
status.moreUsers_other: {{count}} more users have this file open

changeDialog.editDescription: Update the description of this pending changelist.
changeDialog.defaultDescription: Save the default changelist as a numbered changelist, including its opened files.
changeDialog.submitDescription: Submit all opened files in this changelist with the description below.
changeDialog.shelvedSubmit: Remove this changelist's shelved content before submitting.
changeDialog.unavailable: This changelist is no longer pending. Close this dialog and refresh the workspace.
changeDialog.failed: The changelist could not be saved or submitted. Check the operation error and try again.
changeDialog.revertDescription_one: Discard the opened changes in {{count}} file. Added files stay on disk. Shelved files stay on the server.
changeDialog.revertDescription_other: Discard the opened changes in {{count}} files. Added files stay on disk. Shelved files stay on the server.
changeDialog.revertFailed: The files could not be reverted. Check the operation error and try again.

manual.title: Merge {{file}}
manual.hint: Choose or edit each conflict block. Independent changes are merged automatically. Save and resolve after removing all conflict markers; the file is not submitted.
manual.discardHint: The edits in this dialog have not been written to your workspace.
manual.externalHint: Empty uses P4Merge when installed. Custom executables receive four file paths: base, yours, theirs, result. Review the returned result before saving.

reconcileReview.title: Reconcile offline changes
reconcileReview.hint: Only selected files will be opened in the target changelist. Ignore rules are respected; files are not submitted.

streams.title: Integrate streams
streams.noSource: No related source stream is available.
streams.mergeHint: Merge the parent into this workspace. Resolve conflicts and submit from Pending after integration.
streams.copyHint: Copy a child into this workspace. This can replace target content. Preview carefully, then review and submit from Pending.

shelves.title: Team shelves
shelves.description: Find shelved changes across users and workspaces.
shelves.select: Select a shelf to review its files.
shelves.mappingHint: A stream mapping restores the entire shelf between this stream and its parent. Preview the target paths before restoring.
shelves.hint: Restore selected files into the current workspace. The source shelf is kept; conflicts remain for review in Pending.

history.selectionHint: Click: previous revision · Shift-click: set A
history.head: B
history.blameHint: Select a revision; click a changelist to inspect its change.

workspaceSettings.rootHint: Changing the root does not move existing files. Submit, shelve and revert local changes first.
workspaceSettings.generatedHint: Perforce generates these mappings from the stream. Change streams using Switch stream.

hints.allwrite: Files remain writable without checking them out. Use Reconcile to detect offline edits.
hints.clobber: Sync may overwrite writable workspace files.
hints.compress: Compress data transferred between this workspace and the server.
hints.modtime: Use the depot file timestamp when syncing.
hints.rmdir: Delete folders left empty by a sync operation.

switchStream.title: Switch stream
switchStream.shelve: Save local changes to a new shelf
switchStream.backupHint: All local changes are saved together in one new shelf before reverting and switching. Existing shelves are preserved.
switchStream.scopeHint: Generated target mappings. Files in this scope are synced safely to the latest revisions after switching; this is not a file-by-file download estimate.
switchStream.unresolved: Resolve pending integrations before switching streams.
switchStream.finishChanges: Finish local changes, or enable shelving before switching.
switchStream.saveDescription: Save the changelist description before switching streams.
switchStream.restoreHint: Use Team Shelf to open this changelist by number and restore its shelf. If shelving did not finish, inspect its opened files.

result.done: The workspace is synced to the target stream.
result.shelve: Shelving did not finish. The stream was not switched. Inspect the recovery changelist and local files.
result.switch: The stream switch did not finish. Inspect the current stream before retrying.
result.sync: The stream changed, but sync did not finish. Use Get latest to finish syncing.

specs.title: Labels & branch mappings
specs.listLimit: Showing the first 200 results. Narrow the name or owner filter.
specs.select: Select a label or branch mapping
specs.autoHint: An automatic label derives its files from this revision and view. Leave empty to tag individual revisions.
specs.lockHint: Unlock the label before changing its tagged files.
specs.tagHint: Add or remove revision tags without changing workspace files.
specs.noFiles: No file revisions in this label
specs.labelDescription: Define the depot paths included in this label.
specs.branchDescription: Map source depot paths to target depot paths.
specs.name: Name
specs.revisionPlaceholder: @1234 or #1; empty for a static label
specs.deleteHint: Type {{name}} to delete this specification. Workspace and depot files are kept.

integration.title: Merge / Integrate
integration.forceHint: Schedule the selected source revisions again, even if they have already been integrated.
integration.saveDescription: Save the current changelist description before integrating.

properties.title: File properties
properties.typeHelp: Use a full type (text+x, binary+l) to replace the type, or a modifier (+x) to extend it. A full type removes omitted modifiers.
properties.pendingHelp: Changes remain pending until you submit. Opened files keep their current changelists; unopened files are checked out in the chosen changelist.
properties.retention: The +S modifier can purge older depot revisions on a future submit.
properties.head: Head revision

streamSpec.setupHint: Choose a stream location and load its server defaults.
streamSpec.deleteHint: Type the full stream path to confirm deletion.
streamSpec.parentViewHint: Set on creation. Converting the parent view is a separate Perforce operation.

hints.locked: Only the owner can edit a locked stream. Unlock it before deletion.
hints.ownerSubmit: Only the stream owner or members of the owner group can submit.
hints.toParent: Expect changes to flow from this stream to its parent.
hints.fromParent: Expect changes to flow from the parent into this stream.
hints.mergeAny: Allow merges against the usual flow of change.
hints.paths: One mapping per line, such as share ..., exclude build/... or import lib/... //library/main/....
hints.remapped: One relative source and destination pair per line, such as old/... new/....
hints.ignored: File or folder patterns that cannot be submitted, one per line.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.filterHint: Use a Perforce job expression, for example Status=open or User=alice. Leave empty to show all jobs.
jobs.listLimit: Showing 200 jobs. Narrow the filter to find more.
jobs.deleteHint: Type the job name to delete it. Remove its changelist links first.
jobs.formHint: Fields and defaults come from the server’s job definition.
jobs.fixLimit: Showing 200 links. Open a specific job or changelist to narrow the list.
jobs.fixHint: Choose a numbered changelist and the status to apply to the job.
jobs.unlinkHint: Only the link is removed. The job’s current status is preserved.
jobs.applyNow: This changelist is already submitted. Linking it updates the job status immediately.
jobs.applyOnSubmit: The job status changes when this pending changelist is submitted.
jobs.applyKeepStatus: The association is updated. The job’s current status is preserved.

streamWork.title: Stream definition
streamWork.privateHint: Changes stay private to this workspace until the changelist is submitted.
streamWork.unresolved: Resolve the stream fields before submitting.
streamWork.confirmRevert: Type the full stream path to discard the private edit.
streamWork.openHint: Open the definition for private editing, or preview a parent-view conversion.
streamWork.submitHint: Submit the opened files and stream definition in this changelist.

effects.open: The definition opens in the selected changelist. Changes remain private until submitted.
effects.move: Move only the opened stream definition to the selected changelist.
effects.revert: Discard the private stream edit and return to the latest public definition.
effects.parentview: P4 prepares the converted mappings in the selected changelist. Review the changes before submitting.
effects.resolve: Apply this method to the stream fields. Fields left unresolved still need attention before submitting.
effects.unshelve: Restore the shelved stream definition into the selected changelist. Files are excluded; conflicting stream fields need resolving.
effects.deleteShelf: Remove only the shelved stream definition. Shelved files and the current private edit are preserved.

streamWork.confirmDeleteShelf: Type the full stream path to remove its shelved definition.
